detail.longDescription: Hello folks, I support AI advancements and have always believed they will create an entirely new class of jobs and dramatically improve productivity. But if we don't create enough new jobs to replace those lost to AI, how do we prevent deflation? We could be looking at the biggest deflationary period in history. Just printing more money won't be enough when the deflation is productivity based, will it? Nobody can predict what lies ahead, especially with disruption happening at such an unprecedented pace. Where do you see things heading? What new jobs could emerge? Robotics, perhaps?
